paper_metadata.title: Anti-Melanoma Differentiation-Associated protein 5 Auto-Antibodies Promote a Profibrotic Phenotype in a Human Lung Fibroblast Cell Line

supplement_rationale: The paper declares no supplementary material (HAS_SUPPLEMENTARY_MATERIAL_TAG: False); all cell-state and perturbation data are in the main figures.

table_1.context: IMR-90 human fetal lung fibroblast cell line, in vitro
table_1.description: Quiescent/unstimulated IMR-90 fetal lung fibroblasts; untreated control (medium only); baseline proliferation, impedance, gene expression and secretion of TLRs, interferons, ET-1, collagen and pro-collagen
table_1.text_location: Materials and Methods (Cell Culture); Results; Figures 2-9

table_1.context: IMR-90 human fetal lung fibroblast cell line, in vitro
table_1.description: Activated, proliferative, pro-fibrotic IMR-90 fibroblasts; increased impedance/normalized cell index, reduced doubling time, increased cell number, increased secretion of pro-collagen and type I/II interferons, and altered TLR/IFN/ET-1 mRNA program
table_1.text_location: Results (RTCA, MTT/cell count, RT-qPCR, ELISA); Figures 2-9

table_2.description_of_perturbation: Treatment with MDA5-anti-MDA5 immune complex: recombinant human MDA5 protein (1 μg/ml) plus patient-derived polyclonal anti-MDA5 IgG1 antibodies (1 μg/ml)
table_2.context: IMR-90 human fetal lung fibroblast cell line, in vitro
table_2.cell_assay: real-time cell analysis + MTT assay + cell counting + qPCR + ELISA
table_2.delta: Highest normalized cell index throughout later phase, ~25% increase over control at 121 h; doubling time reduced ~8 h (54.4 h control vs 46.8 h); cell number approximately doubled at 5 d; no acute cytotoxicity by MTT; downregulation of TLR2, TLR7, IFN-β and ET-1 mRNA; pro-collagen and interferon secretion detectable but reduced relative to antibody-alone; additive/synergistic pro-fibrotic activation
table_2.mechanism: Antibody-antigen immune complexes drive fibroblast activation via Fc-mediated activation of the classical complement pathway; complement-inactivated serum abolished the response, and the effect is not neutralized but summed relative to single agents
table_2.sample_size: n=3-4 replicate wells per condition, 2 independent experiments

table_2.description_of_perturbation: Treatment with patient-derived polyclonal anti-MDA5 IgG1 antibodies alone (1 μg/ml)
table_2.context: IMR-90 human fetal lung fibroblast cell line, in vitro
table_2.cell_assay: real-time cell analysis + MTT assay + qPCR + ELISA
table_2.delta: Moderate increase in normalized cell index from ~60-70 h; most active condition for inducing significantly increased secretion of IFN-α, IFN-β, IFN-γ and pro-collagen α1; downregulation of TLR2, TLR7, IFN-α, IFN-β and ET-1 mRNA; slight non-significant downward trend in MTT viability; no acute cytotoxicity
table_2.mechanism: Autoantibody-driven activation dependent on Fc-mediated classical complement activation; complement-inactivated serum completely abolished the RTCA response to anti-MDA5 antibodies
table_2.sample_size: n=3-4 replicate wells per condition, 2 independent experiments

table_2.description_of_perturbation: Treatment with recombinant human MDA5 protein alone (1 μg/ml)
table_2.context: IMR-90 human fetal lung fibroblast cell line, in vitro
table_2.cell_assay: real-time cell analysis + MTT assay + qPCR
table_2.delta: Moderate increase in normalized cell index from ~60-70 h (limited vs immune complex); significant reduction of TLR2, TLR7, TLR8, IFN-α, IFN-β and ET-1 mRNA; no acute cytotoxicity and no significant MTT viability change
table_2.mechanism: Extracellular MDA5 antigen proposed to act as a primary trigger for pro-pathogenic reprogramming of lung fibroblasts
table_2.sample_size: n=3-4 replicate wells per condition, 2 independent experiments
